Class EventSystem

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.events.EventSystem
public class EventSystem extends Object
Manages historical milestones, contingency leader interventions, and stochastic events in the simulation. Event Types: - Historical Milestones: Pre-defined technological and civilizational markers - Earth Historical Leaders: Deterministic historical figures (Alexander, Augustus, Hammurabi, etc.) - Procedural Leader Outliers: Emergent high-sigma leaders and reformers in sandbox/procedural worlds - Geophysical invalid input: '&' Natural Disasters: Volcanism, floods, earthquakes, famines, pandemics
